listing.description:
Make the shower easy and fun with this printable bridal shower games bundle in a soft sage greenery design. Download, print at home, and play.

WHAT'S INCLUDED (16 pages)
- Bridal Bingo (gift opening game)
- Find the Guest
- He Said, She Said
- Who Knows the Bride Best? (20 questions)
- Would She Rather
- Emoji Pictionary
- Word Scramble
- Word Search
- Advice for the Bride cards
- Date Night Idea cards
- "Let the Games Begin" sign
- Prize tags
- Answer keys for Emoji Pictionary, Word Scramble and Word Search

FILES
- US Letter PDF (8.5 x 11 in)
- A4 PDF (210 x 297 mm)

HOW IT WORKS
1. Purchase and download the files from your Etsy account (Purchases and reviews).
2. Print at 100% (actual size) on regular paper or light cardstock, at home or at a print shop.
3. Print one game sheet per guest, and one copy of the sign and card pages.

PLEASE NOTE
- This is a digital download. No physical item will be shipped.
- The files are not editable.
- Colors may look slightly different depending on your screen and printer.
- For personal use only. Please don't share or resell the files.

Designed by our shop with the help of AI tools for writing and layout. Every page is checked and finished by us.

Questions? Send us a message, we're happy to help.
